reason: The cited minified line includes the get_tasks registration and implementation: it calls n.tasks.list(...) using the project context and returns the resulting tasks array in the MCP response via Y(...), so it returns project/task data from the user's Task Master storage into the agent context. Those task fields are project-authored content and may be controlled by whoever controls the project/task data, so the returned content is untrusted. The shown get_tasks path does not evaluate code, spawn commands, or otherwise provide arbitrary host code execution, and it does not send agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination; it only logs and returns data to the MCP caller.
